audit.scope: Protected-merged modern sequencer, timeline, playback, and sequencer-adjacent platform slices on current main.

gaps.rationale: The initial ledger contains only releases whose protected head, merge, and source evidence were reverified; older planning RELEASE prose still requires protected-main reconciliation before the audit may be called complete.

The Product A registry has generic state and test-input operations, including a transport-shaped test event, but no sequencer or timeline document capability ID, operation, executor, or policy projection.

PR #7644 protected-delivered the backend, but planning acceptance remains held until a fresh PULP_IOS_REQUIRE_SIMULATOR=1 run captures the live virtual-CoreMIDI source/destination enumeration, bidirectional I/O, teardown, and disappearance artifact. A released delivery row records merge provenance only and does not release that planning claim.
